brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items were met with active doctor inquiry, risk communication, medication safety warnings, privacy-respecting communication guidance, executable action plans, and teach-back confirmation. At least two high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO4) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact—age-appropriate communication scripts, family conflict navigation into concrete role assignment, and clear bounded closure with residual uncertainties. No responsibility-chain errors present. Grade 5 Perfect.
